use_case_name: Associate Related Surveillance Tracks and Points

claims.content: The C2 JU uses the J7.7 Track Association message to associate related surveillance tracks and points when it is determined that multiple Track Numbers are reporting information for the same target or to indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU uses the J7.7 Track Association message to associate related surveillance tracks and points when it is determined that multiple Track Numbers are reporting information for the same target or to indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point.

claims.content: C2 JU
Multiple Track Numbers (TNs) must be reporting information for the same target or there must be a need to indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point.
The C2 JU must have determined that an association between tracks or points is required.
The C2 JU recognizes that two tracks being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation or that multiple Track Numbers are reporting information for the same target.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU recognizes that two tracks being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation or that multiple Track Numbers are reporting information for the same target.

claims.content: The C2 JU uses the J7.7 message to indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point.
The J7.7 message is transmitted when the C2 JU determines that multiple Track Numbers are reporting information for the same target or when an association between tracks/points is required.
If it is determined that the association no longer exists, the JU which originated the association shall terminate it.
The J7.7 message may be transmitted with ACT = 0 to associate data or ACT = 1 to terminate an association.
JUs should purge received J7.7 data if it has not been updated after a specified optional time interval.
An association shall be terminated by the JU which originated the association when it is determined that the association no longer exists.
JUs should purge received J7.7 data if it has not been updated after a specified optional time interval.
The J7.7 message has been successfully transmitted to indicate an association between a track/point and another track/point.
If the association is later determined to no longer exist, it shall be terminated by the JU which originated the association.
Received J7.7 data shall be purged by JUs if it has not been updated after a specified optional time interval.
